name: Lumina Input Control
description: Mouse + keyboard automation with per-process allowlist and audit log. Phase 6. Disabled by default — opt-in once Phase 5 is comfortable.

appAllowlist.description: Process names (without .exe) where Lumina acts without per-action confirmation. Match is case-insensitive.

denylistAlways.description: Process names where Lumina MUST NEVER act, even with confirmation. Hard veto.

confirmationMode.description: What to do for off-allowlist apps. 'block' returns needs_confirmation and refuses to act; 'log_only' lets the agent act and only audits (NOT recommended in production).

auditLogPath.description: Override path to the audit JSONL. Defaults to ~/.lumina/input-control/audit.jsonl.

maxTypingChars.description: Hard cap on the length of any single typing request.
